So, this right here is our perfect example of our dogee rejection candlestick and our bullish engulfing candlestick. For this example, this market is headed to the upside after having a push to the upside. We've just retested and as of right now, we are giving us this confirmation. Now, if this candlestick is currently fluctuating and moving up and down and it is yet to be closed, that is the market still anticipating this move. Up until this candlestick closes right at the end, whether it's the 1 minute, the 4 hour, the daily, the weekly, the monthly, the yearly, as soon as that candlestick closes, it is a confirmation. One second before it closes, it is an entire anticipation. I've seen candlesticks in the last 5 seconds before closing completely change direction.
